evidence_quotes:
Use only
Dexron® III for 4L80-E transmission.

In arctic conditions, use OEA in both
model transmissions.
statements.reason: The 4L80-E requires Dexron® III; the stated arctic exception uses OEA.
statements.statement: In non-arctic service, Dexron® II may not be used in the 4L80-E transmission.

statements.reason: The manual also specifies OEA for both transmission models in arctic conditions.
statements.statement: The manual allows only Dexron® III in the 4L80-E transmission.

evidence_quotes:
Failure to use only Dexron® III for
4L80E transmission will cause damage
to transmission.
statements.reason: The manual warns that failing to use only Dexron® III will cause damage.
statements.statement: Using Dexron® II in the 4L80-E transmission will damage the transmission.

evidence_quotes: Use Dexron® II for filling transfer case.
statements.reason: The transfer-case filling instruction gives no transmission-type qualification.
statements.statement: The manual specifies Dexron® II for transfer-case filling regardless of transmission type.

evidence_quotes: Use Dexron® II for filling transfer case.
statements.reason: The transfer-case instruction specifies Dexron® II without an arctic-condition restriction.
statements.statement: The manual does not restrict transfer-case use of Dexron® II to arctic conditions.

statements.reason: No model 218 fill quantity is supplied.
statements.statement: On level ground, the model 218 transfer case should be filled with 3.5 quarts (3.3 L).

statements.reason: No model 242 fill quantity is supplied.
statements.statement: On level ground, the model 242 transfer case should be filled with 3.35 quarts (3.17 L).
